# `tools/inspector/ui/InspectorTheme.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/inspector/ui/InspectorTheme.js`

InspectorTheme.js - Unified theme system for all inspector panels Provides consistent colors, spacing, and styling across all inspector UI.

## Functions

### `applyThemeStyles(el, styles)`

Apply theme styles to an element

**Parameters:**

- `el` *(HTMLElement)* — Element to style
- `styles` *(Object)* — Style object from theme

### `createThemedButton(doc, text, variant = "primary", onClick)`

Create a themed button

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document
- `text` *(string)* — Button text
- `variant` *(string)* — 'primary' or 'secondary'
- `onClick` *(Function)* — Click handler

### `createThemedInput(doc, type = "text")`

Create a themed input

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document
- `type` *(string)* — Input type

### `createThemedLabel(doc, text)`

Create a themed label

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document
- `text` *(string)* — Label text

### `createThemedSectionHeader(doc, text, icon = "")`

Create a themed section header

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document
- `text` *(string)* — Header text
- `icon` *(string)* — Optional emoji icon

### `createThemedTab(doc, text, isActive = false, onClick)`

Create a themed tab button

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document
- `text` *(string)* — Tab text
- `isActive` *(boolean)* — Is tab active
- `onClick` *(Function)* — Click handler

### `createThemedBadge(doc, text, color = "info")`

Create a themed badge

**Parameters:**

- `doc` *(Document)* — Document
- `text` *(string)* — Badge text
- `color` *(string)* — Color key from theme.colors.category or theme.colors.semantic
